svg.title: Event-driven report generation
svg.desc: 1. Accepting the job (202 Accepted) 2. Generating and storing the PDF 3. Downloading with a signed URL

g.text: The dashboard requests a monthly report
API Gateway enqueues the job and
The browser downloads the PDF from
S3 without going through the API
PDF generation is too slow to run in the request, so the job goes to SQS and the API
SQS triggers the Lambda worker, which generates the PDF and stores it in S3.
When the report is ready, the client downloads it directly from S3 with a presigned
